Title: Standard_NC24rs_v3 virtual machines will be retired on March 31st, 2025

Body.Content:
On March 31st, 2025, Microsoft Azure will retire the Standard_NC24rs_v3 virtual machine (VM) size in NCv3-series virtual machines (VMs). To avoid any disruption to your service we recommend that you change the VM sizing for your workloads from the current Standard_NC24rs_v3 to the newer VM series in the same NC product line.

Required Action 
Evaluate your best path for migration by reviewing the additional virtual machines option here.

Help and support 
You can ask questions at Microsoft Q&A. If you have a support plan and you need technical help, please create a support request.
